(2) Wide-angle shots reveal an extensive outdoor park facility featuring rope bridges, circular rings, and black safety netting built under a massive concrete highway viaduct. (3) The woman is shown in various states of physical exertion: climbing a vertical wooden fence, navigating suspended wooden platforms, and walking across a rope bridge while wearing a sun hat. (4) A man in a blue athletic shirt is seen hanging from gym rings and attempting to climb a colorful bouldering wall before falling back with a smile. (5) Quick cuts show a brown Shiba Inu dog peering over a wooden gate and the woman walking past a sports equipment rental booth with a chalkboard sign. (6) Cinematic aerial footage transitions to a white lighthouse situated on a lush green cliffside overlooking a vast blue ocean under a clear sky. (7) The screen displays a mobile app interface featuring photos of people and Greenpeace branding, accompanied by colorful emojis and text overlays. (8) Back to a medium shot, the woman stands in a park, gesturing and speaking directly to the camera while looking composed and friendly.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Fast-paced female narration begins with an enthusiastic, high-arousal pitch; upbeat electronic BGM kicks in with a prominent 4/4 kick drum and bright synth lead. (2) A 'ding' sound effect punctuates the mention of the park's difficulty, while faint outdoor ambiance can be heard during speech pauses. (3) A sharp 'whoosh' transition leads to a rhythmic sequence where small percussive 'thuds' and cloth rustling are heard as the narrator physically exerts herself in the obstacle course. (4) A male voice briefly exclaims with laughter and high pitch after a 'thud' sound suggesting a fall from the climbing wall. (5) The narration transitions to a slightly lower, more informative tone as environmental wind noise is briefly captured during a scenic aerial transition. (6) 'Pop' and 'digital UI' sound effects trigger rapidly in sync with the appearance of the Greenpeace campaign graphics. (7) Final segment features the female voice returning to a bright, persuasive tone over the continuous upbeat music, concluding with a sharp fade out.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses the review of a high-difficulty urban park as a hook to discuss the impact of rising temperatures in Taiwan, ultimately promoting a Greenpeace photo-collection campaign focused on climate change awareness.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of Greenpeace branding, mention of a specific campaign website, and a clear call to action to upload photos.
